tools.name: get_usdt_rub_rate
tools.description: Current SAIKYO rate for buying USDT (TRC20) with rubles via SBP QR through Omega Wallet, plus a market reference buy/sell rate.

tools.name: get_foreign_card_terms
tools.description: Terms of the Omega Wallet virtual Visa card for residents of Russia: price, fees, top-up methods, requirements and caveats.

tools.name: how_to_pay_from_russia
tools.description: Payment options from Russia for a foreign service (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Cursor, Steam, Netflix, Airbnb and 1,000+ others) with guide links.

tools.name: get_payment_passport
tools.description: Payment facts for 900+ foreign services from official pages: accepted payment methods, Russia availability, official gift cards, crypto acceptance, billing-country checks and source URLs.

tools.name: travel_card_for_country
tools.description: Card payment tips for Russians travelling to a country: local currency, popular apps, caveats and guide link. Omit country to list all guides.

tools.name: search_saikyo_shop
tools.description: Search Saikyo Shop digital goods paid in rubles: AI subscriptions, gift cards, game top-ups, Telegram Stars, software.

tools.name: list_exchange_directions
tools.description: Use when the user asks which SAIKYO crypto exchange directions are available, including RUB via SBP QR (Omega Wallet) and USDT TRC20/TON/Polygon/BEP20/ERC20. Returns live Omega Wallet quotes for every USDT network, limits (RUB 100–10,000,000), reserve and order link.

tools.name: find_exchange_route
tools.description: Use when the user wants to exchange rubles, RUB or SBP QR for USDT (TRC20, TON, Polygon, BEP20, ERC20). Resolves Russian and English currency terms and returns the live SAIKYO quote and order link.

tools.name: calculate_exchange
tools.description: Use for an exact SAIKYO quote from RUB via SBP QR (Omega Wallet) to USDT. Returns the live Omega Wallet rate, network fee, amounts, limits, reserve and order link.

tools.name: start_exchange_order
tools.description: Use when the user wants to continue with a RUB via SBP QR (Omega Wallet) to USDT exchange. Returns the live quote, a prefilled link and the steps the user completes on the site. Does not submit an order.

tools.name: check_wallet_aml
tools.description: Use when the user asks to screen a crypto wallet address for AML risk. Supports TRON, EVM, Bitcoin and TON addresses and returns an indicative screening result.

tools.name: get_exchanger_info
tools.description: Use when the user asks about SAIKYO domains, published support channels, automatic exchange mode, white-crypto/licensed partners, AML/KYC policy or exchange directions. Each section includes a source URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_payment_passport, get_exchanger_info · Private data: get_usdt_rub_rate, get_foreign_card_terms, list_exchange_directions, calculate_exchange, start_exchange_order, check_wallet_aml · Public sink: start_exchange_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_payment_passport, get_exchanger_info · Private data: get_usdt_rub_rate, get_foreign_card_terms, list_exchange_directions, calculate_exchange, start_exchange_order, check_wallet_aml · Public sink: start_exchange_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
